verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's own Entity Management API can look up an entity by UEI (up to 100 values) or by partial legal business name, and the samRegistered parameter distinguishes registered from not-yet-registered entities, so a founder can check registration status programmatically. However, the API requires a Public API Key tied to a SAM.gov account, and no evidence shows a status-lookup feature on the public sam.gov pages themselves. Missing for 10: a documented public web page for checking registration or application status, keyless access, clear in-progress or pending status states, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
